summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite filed a Form 6-K providing a Q2 2026 operational update. The filing details completion of a C$427M equity financing package including a C$295M private placement and release of C$132M from subscription receipts, alongside a US$335M debt commitment, enabling FID for the Matawinie Mine. It also notes a take-or-pay supply agreement with the Government of Canada and a letter of intent with Eni for a potential offtake. These are routine business updates, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction terms, premiums, or recommendations are provided.
